title: Email
subtitle: Domains, DNS, mailboxes, and relay
externalTodos: Tasks you must handle outside the server
ptr: Reverse DNS (PTR) must be set by your VPS/cloud provider
port25: Outbound Port 25 may be blocked; request unblock or use a relay
createHint: After create, review DNS, mailboxes, and health checks
emptyHint: Create a domain to get DNS records and external todos
softwareNeeded: Required email software is not installed
emptyCreateHint: Use Create in the toolbar to register a domain; then open detail for bootstrap and DNS.
queueHint: Click View queue to read the local Postfix queue. Without EXECUTE or postqueue you will see the failure reason.
mtaBody: Probe and one-click install are driven by the banner above. The list page does not pretend software is installed.
mtaMissingHint: When software is missing the banner shows install / re-probe. Install success ≠ domain can send/receive.
path2: Open domain detail → one-click mail setup
path3: Add MX / SPF / DKIM / DMARC on DNS page or external checklist
opsThisPage: This page: domain registry, queue view, software probe
opsDetail: Domain detail: bootstrap, mailboxes, aliases, relay, webmail
opsHost: Host provider: PTR, Port 25 outbound policy
opsRegistrar: Registrar: publish MX / SPF / DKIM / DMARC
statusWritten: written: management files written, may not be live
statusApplied: applied: successfully applied before (still check service is-active)
statusReputation: Inbox reputation can never be 100% automated
createModalDesc: Finish install and DNS on the detail page
domainApexHint: apex domain, e.g. example.com (no mail. prefix)
serverIpv4Hint: Public IPv4 for this domain mail (MX / A / SPF ip4:)
serverIpv6Hint: If public v6, write AAAA and SPF ip6:
registerNote: Register success ≠ mail works. Finish bootstrap, DNS and SSL on domain detail.
flushConfirmDesc: This cannot be undone; queued messages will be deleted.
dnsTodosDesc: Suggested records can be copied to external DNS or DNS page zones (write ≠ authoritative)
externalTodosBody: PTR, Port 25, registrar DNS, reputation — complete at host/registrar; copy SPF/DKIM then add on DNS page or external panel.
refreshDnsHint: Click Refresh (top-right) to load DNS suggestions
mailboxListDesc: After create, can write Dovecot password DB (needs system change rights)
noMailboxes: No mailboxes yet — click Create mailbox
autoreplyDesc: Control-plane flags + dataDir draft; written ≠ MTA/Sieve live
autoreplyBodyHint: Default writes control plane + dataDir (written). Apply to system installs Postfix REJECT map and Dovecot .dovecot.sieve (needs EXECUTE+root).
applyToSystemDesc: Needs YSK_EXECUTE=1 + root; failures are not faked as success
subject: Subject
defaultAutoreplyBody: We received your email and will reply later.
healthLiveDesc: Live MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR/outbound 25/DNSBL; results write back domain health score
healthExternalNote: You must handle outside panel: provider PTR, outbound Port 25, registrar DS (DNSSEC). These are real queries, not fake green lights.
noLiveYetHint: Click Run live check for real public DNS/port probes
mailSslHint: Real issue is on SSL page; jump to mail / webmail / domain hostnames here
rateLimitDesc: Writes Postfix anvil and Rspamd settings (applied only with YSK_EXECUTE + root)
relayDesc: Send via external SMTP; system apply writes Postfix (needs system change rights)
webmailSsoDesc: Issue one-time token; webmail must accept it. Does not claim full Roundcube integration
mailboxPasswordHint: For real auto-login as postmaster@{{domain}}; empty = token only
mailboxPasswordPh: With password, token can auto-login Roundcube
ssoTokenHint: Token valid ~10 minutes; for admin panel test/integration, not end-user flow.
sieveTemplateHint: Write default template for postmaster@{{domain}} (includes spam fileinto comment sample).
domainSslDesc: Jump to SSL page with domain prefilled for Let’s Encrypt
clientAutoDesc: Generate Mozilla Autoconfig / Outlook Autodiscover XML
clientAutoHint: After generate, tries to copy Mozilla XML to clipboard; see ops result below.
queueDesc: Query or flush local MTA queue (also on email home; needs system change rights)
bootstrapDesc: Install packages and apply mail stack (needs system change + admin). Custom admin password required.
adminPasswordRequired: Set an admin password of at least 8 characters
passwordOptionalHint8: Optional; hash written only if at least 8 chars

live.port25Open: Outbound TCP 25 appears open (probe to gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com)
live.port25Blocked: Outbound TCP 25 probe failed — may be blocked; request unblock or use relay

deliv.mxFix: Add MX at DNS provider pointing to mail host
deliv.ptrFix: Set PTR at VPS/cloud console to match mail hostname — panel cannot set this
deliv.port25Fix: Request Port 25 unlock from hoster, or configure SMTP relay (submission 587)
deliv.dnsblFix: Delist at listed services; stop sending until clean
deliv.relayPresent: Relay config present under dataDir (apply may still need EXECUTE)
deliv.relayMissing: No relay configured — required if Port 25 stays blocked
deliv.relayFix: Panel Email → Relay, or ysk-server hosting email-bootstrap with relay
deliv.warmupFix: Follow phase limits; do not blast cold lists from a new IP
deliv.honesty1: Panel never guarantees worldwide inbox delivery (Gmail/Outlook filtering is external).
deliv.honesty2: PTR and Port 25 are owned by the VPS/network provider — not by YSK control plane.
deliv.honesty3: DNS MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC must be published at the authoritative DNS provider.
deliv.honestyPortBlocked: Port 25 appears blocked — use relay or request unlock before high volume.
deliv.honestyPortOk: Port 25 probe succeeded — still monitor bounces and DNSBL.

warmup.p1g2: Monitor bounces; keep complaint rate near zero
warmup.p1g3: Ensure SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR are live before volume
warmup.p2g1: Expand slowly to engaged contacts only
warmup.p2g2: Check DNSBL daily; pause if listed
warmup.p2g3: Prefer 587 submission over bulk on port 25 if restricted
warmup.p3g1: Double volume only if metrics stay clean
warmup.p3g2: Segment lists; remove hard bounces immediately
warmup.p4g1: Approach normal volume if no blocks
warmup.c2: SPF + DKIM + DMARC published and aligned
warmup.c3: DNSBL clean on Spamhaus / SpamCop / Barracuda
warmup.c4: Outbound port 25 open or relay configured
warmup.c6: Domain age / history considered (new domains = slower ramp)
warmup.noteNewIp: Treat this IP as new — start at phase day 1–3 limits
warmup.noteOldIp: Existing IP still benefits from gradual ramp after config changes
warmup.noteProcess: Warm-up is operator process; YSK tracks tips + DNSBL, not marketing ESP volume

health.ptrBad: PTR reverse DNS missing or incorrect — request at VPS provider
health.port25Blocked: Outbound Port 25 appears blocked — request unblock or use SMTP relay
health.port25Unknown: Port 25 status unknown — run connectivity check

stack.tlsNote: TLS certs via Let’s Encrypt for SMTP/IMAP
stack.externalNote: External DNS/PTR/Port25 still required for deliverability

test.needMta: Requires local MTA (Postfix) installed and Port 25/relay configured
test.checkSpam: Check recipient spam folder and server mail logs after send
test.hintDeferred: If deferred: check Port 25 block or relay credentials
test.hintSpam: If accepted but spam: improve SPF/DKIM/DMARC/PTR and warm-up

applyMailTlsHint: Cert must already exist under /etc/letsencrypt/live/mail.<domain>. This only sets Postfix/Dovecot paths and reloads — it does not run certbot.
dnsAuthRepairHint: Copy suggested records from the DNS tab, publish them, then re-run live check.
fixHintSpf: SPF failed: publish a v=spf1 TXT at @.
fixHintMx: MX failed: point MX to mail.<domain>.

mailTls.needRootExecute: Applying mail TLS needs root and YSK_EXECUTE.
mailTls.getCertFirst: Issue a Let’s Encrypt cert for {{host}} on the SSL page first.
mailTls.dovecotApplied: Wrote Dovecot TLS snippet and attempted reload.
mailTls.dovecotSkipped: Skipped Dovecot (not installed or doveconf unavailable).

policyApplySystemHint: Check “apply to system” to write Postfix/Rspamd maps and reload; otherwise only control-plane draft is saved.
rateLimitAppliedNote: Hourly outbound rate and antispam flag applied (when system apply is on).
bootstrapHonesty: One-click bootstrap writes MTA configs and mailboxes under the panel data directory. Applying packages/services needs root + YSK_EXECUTE. DNS/PTR/Port 25/mail SSL remain operator-owned.
bootstrapAfterSteps: Next: ① publish DNS (MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC) ② issue mail SSL ③ Apply mail TLS paths.

bootstrap.mailTlsTodo: Mail TLS: issue a cert for {{mailHost}}, then use Apply mail TLS paths on the health tab.
bootstrap.externalDns: External (operator-owned): set MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC at DNS; PTR at VPS; Port 25 or SMTP relay.
